Claim 1 (Currently amended): A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein said desiccant is selected to enhance thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, and wherein said desiccant contributes to the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, wherein said desiccant enhances the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition, and wherein said extrusion aid is selected to facilitate processing without compromising thermal stability.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, and wherein the composition is configured to optimize thermal stability.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, and wherein the selected carboxylic acid contributes to the thermal stability of the composition.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A gas generating system comprising: a gas generator comprising a composition, said composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and said composition further containing a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein said desiccant is selected to enhance thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, wherein said desiccant is selected to enhance thermal stability of the composition.
